items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: He used to play Kodgen. Old man Ford. He used to play Kodgen. That was a band.

ctx.x: I just forget this boy's name. He used to play Kodgen. What did he call it? Old man Ford. He used to play Kodgen. That was a band. They had a Kodgen, a Kodgen and a Washboard. And that was a band. And that was a band. Who played the Kodgen?
I don't know. Did he have a separate guy to do it? Or would Ford play it?
The one who was playing the band, the Washboard. Oh yeah? He'd have that Kodgen. I got one of them little Kodgen home. A little tin Kodgen. That's what he'd play.
